string-array.name: changelog_51
string-array.item: Wireless: if a VPN on the phone keeps myCar off the car\'s Wi-Fi, myCar now says so within seconds, on Home and in its notification, and tells you how to fix it.
Apps that turn myCar away, such as ABRP, now say why in plain words, get a red X and no longer start by themselves.

string-array.name: changelog_50
string-array.item: New Jolly key in the dock, above the microphone: one tap does what you choose: call a contact, talk to an AI, run something in Home Assistant (a scene, a light, the gate), go to a place, give the assistant a command or open an app. Hold it to change it, in the car or on the phone in Settings > Car screen. Don\'t need it? Turn it off there and the dock is as before.

A call under way is now a small bubble over every screen until it ends, with the photo of who you\'re talking to, how long it has lasted and a red button to hang up. Tap it for the Phone; hold it and drag it anywhere, and it stays there for the next calls too.

Spotify Web: a button on the cover of the player beside the map turns on video covers: songs with a Canvas play their short looping video in place of the cover, until you tap it again (also in Settings). If no video shows, open Spotify\'s Now playing view once and pick its Canvas view.
The split screens (map and music, an app beside the map, the pages) are now soft rounded panels raised above the wallpaper.

Wireless start-up: a home Wi-Fi with addresses like the car\'s no longer holds it up for minutes, myCar starts over at once when the car\'s wireless adapter restarts, and it calls the adapter again a few seconds after its Bluetooth comes up.
New \"Keep the car\'s radio until the phone plays\": with the sound through myCar, the car stays on its own radio (DAB+, FM) until something plays on the phone.

After you switch to the car\'s radio, a map\'s voice, a web page or the assistant no longer take it away, and spoken turns, answers and the listening beep lower the radio and give it back, as Android Auto does.
With the sound through myCar, when the car takes the speakers for a moment (its own voice, an announcement), the phone\'s music pauses and starts again afterwards instead of playing unheard.
Spotify Web starts by itself at the start of a drive, even when the car\'s radio presses Play again while the page is still loading.

When the phone\'s voice can\'t speak, myCar shows the answer and brings the music back within seconds, and Voice in myCar\'s settings on the phone tells you which voice is missing. The big voice model loads only on longer drives, and only when the phone has the memory for it.
If Home Assistant\'s voice assistant has lost its conversation agent, myCar asks one that still exists, or tells you what to fix.
Screen sharing keeps the phone\'s screen on, turns the phone the way the car\'s picture is, keeps the music playing in the car, and tells you how to get back to myCar.
On the cable: Home tells you what to check when the phone charges but no car answers (on GrapheneOS, the USB-C port setting), and the first setup explains what each car audio choice means.
A car with an upright screen gets an upright picture when it offers one, and Screen fit no longer says \"No vehicle profile matched\".
A Waze modified with Morphe that doesn\'t accept myCar gets a red X, and the car tells you what to add to the patch.

From Gearslip: alerts from car apps on the car\'s screen (Waze asks whether a hazard is still there), older Hyundai cars that stopped at the start, spoken turns that come back when the voice didn\'t start, music that starts again by itself after the drive put back on pause, Metrolist\'s like button, AntennaPod\'s Next chapter, and the name you gave your car in Bluetooth.

Cars that kept their screen black with the music on Bluetooth (such as the Mitsubishi Mirage 2024) get it after 5 seconds, and at once when myCar knows them; Toyota head units that stopped before a wireless start get the answer they wait for; and for cars that need it, the phone\'s Bluetooth address can be written in Settings > Connection.
The session report says whether the car switched off, went silent or dropped its Wi-Fi while driving.

string-array.name: changelog_49
string-array.item: Xonos inside myCar now has the engine of Xonos 0.1.55: an artist opens without loading all its songs first (they load when you open \"All tracks\"), and the car\'s menu waits for Music Assistant instead of showing empty folders.
With Music Assistant on your phone, in the Xonos app: playing, skipping and picking a song wait up to a minute while it starts again, instead of saying it isn\'t connected.

Steadier Xonos: a sound decoder that breaks down is replaced, the sign-in is renewed before it runs out, and Spotify, left busy in Music Assistant by a stream nobody hears any more, is freed when no other player uses it (with an admin account).
If the car is switched off while the network is down or during a call, Xonos no longer starts again from the phone\'s speaker when the network returns or the call ends.
After you pick an album or a playlist in the car, the player no longer keeps showing its name instead of the song that is playing. Songs without a cover now show Xonos\'s song icon.

string-array.name: changelog_48
string-array.item: Autoplay no longer plays on the phone\'s speaker, in your pocket, when the car\'s Bluetooth music isn\'t connected yet: it waits for it up to a minute, and a pause or a song you choose meanwhile stays.

string-array.name: changelog_47
string-array.item: The map no longer stays black, without its position, when the car\'s Wi-Fi drops and comes back during a drive, or when the car connects while myCar is left open on the locked phone.
With pirate speak, the voice and the phone numbers follow your phone\'s country again.

string-array.name: changelog_46
string-array.item: Fixed a crash that closed myCar and ended the drive: it came after a tap in Plancia\'s page, then a turn to the map or the app grid, the Plancia app taking its place, or a change of theme.
Pirate speak: in Settings > Language, every text of myCar in pirate terms, in your language. We chart our own course.
A new moving wallpaper, myCar · Rebel: the waves, and a pirate ship that rides out every storm with its skull and crossbones.
If myCar ever closes by itself, the next start writes in the log why Android closed it (a crash, memory, not responding), so it can be fixed.
The voice models load one at a time, never after the drive is over, and before the first command only with memory to spare.
Mini player: on small screens it starts clear of the map\'s buttons, let go under them it moves just clear, and the map\'s faded buttons no longer take taps meant for the map.
Lyrics: every song starts from its first line, and a live version of another song no longer brings its words.
Spotify and the other music services: \"play …\" waits up to 25 seconds for the page, and a Play still waiting doesn\'t start once you\'ve changed the music.
Choosing the car\'s radio stops a video or a radio playing in Cinema or the browser, and they don\'t start again by themselves. Autoplay starts the music only once the sound has a way to the car.

Assistant: \"next\", \"pause\" or \"stop\" inside a longer question no longer change the song; \"don\'t send\" and \"cancel\" are heard while you answer a message; a pause right before another music command no longer cancels it.
What\'s new waits for a call to end, and during a call the pages beside the map and their menu stay below the call\'s bar.
Changing myCar\'s language during a drive changes the car\'s screen at once; on Android 12 and 13, opening myCar during a drive gives the map its position back.

string-array.name: changelog_45
string-array.item: Mini player over the whole map: close the player beside the map and a small player floats over the map, with the cover, back, play or pause and next. Hold it, then drag it anywhere; its X hides it for the drive (the song in the dock brings the player back), and Settings can turn it off.

Song lyrics found far more often: titles cleaned of \"Remastered\", \"feat.\", \"Live\" and the names radios and videos add, and every result checked, so another song\'s lyrics never show. Instrumental tracks say so; with Xonos inside myCar, Music Assistant\'s lyrics come first.
A song without lyrics shows one short line instead of an empty panel, and beside the map the player comes back by itself.
The map gets your position with the phone locked in your pocket: myCar takes it as the car arrives. If Android still refuses, the car says so, only when you\'re stopped.
The map starts at its final width: the music\'s column is kept from the start of the drive, so the map isn\'t drawn twice.
Autoplay is on by default, and the player beside the map also comes Extra large (40% bigger).
No more \"Spotify is playing on another device\" at every song change.

string-array.name: changelog_44
string-array.item: Hide an app from the car\'s app grid: hold it and choose \"Hide from the app grid\". It comes back from Settings, Hidden apps, or from the phone (Car screen, Apps on the car\'s app grid).
With Spotify or another music service inside myCar, \"Hide the phone\'s Spotify app\" keeps one Spotify on the grid; its pinned icon and the choice beside the map go to the one inside myCar.
The player beside the map in three sizes, Small, Medium and Large (10% and 20% bigger), in the car\'s settings and on the phone.
During a call the screens move below the call\'s bar, so Back, the tabs and Stop stay within reach, and a ringing call closes the assistant.
Connecting by itself: the phone in a pocket keeps listening for the car after a drive, a try that starts over no longer shows the red card, and turning myCar off stops a start under way.

Messages that say the real cause: the certificate or the car\'s date over Wi-Fi, a cable start that stalls (with what to do), and a car screen that can\'t be drawn (myCar closes and says so instead of a black screen).
Sound: spoken turns follow each car\'s route and keep quiet during calls; Cinema pauses when the car switches to the radio and starts after a call ends.
Voice: the phone says the assistant is ready only with every model it needs, and the first setup offers the voice download again.

The map stays put when the music changes: the player\'s column waits a few seconds before closing, so Vela and other maps keep their surface, and beside the player the area they draw around is the right one.

Spotify and the other music services inside myCar: opening one plays the song in its bar, Autoplay waits until the page is ready, the music plays on after the car\'s screen is rebuilt, and myCar says when Spotify plays on another device.

Assistant: one pause from question to answer, no listening while a call rings, its voice back at the next drive if the phone\'s speech engine had stopped, and the wheel\'s voice key during screen sharing brings myCar back.

Also: the lyrics\' X brings the player back, a new choice beside the map shows at once, the car\'s Back closes What\'s new and the Bluetooth cards, and \"Done\" after signing in to a music service. The car\'s screen is in the language chosen for myCar even when the phone\'s is another.

string-array.name: changelog_43
string-array.item: Spotify\'s sign-in on the phone is no longer black: the page shows and can be filled in, as for every music service.
Paste in the car\'s keyboard works: the keyboard stays open and what you copied on the phone goes into the field.
The browser and Cinema show pages at their real height: YouTube\'s bottom bar, cookie notices and full-window pages appear as in a browser.

Connecting by itself: the phone in a pocket stays awake while it waits for the car, it tries to reach the car for a whole minute, and an \"Allow\" closed without an answer no longer turns it off for good.
With the phone\'s Wi-Fi off, myCar says so at once; on Android 17 it asks for the local network permission the car\'s Wi-Fi needs.
Music that doesn\'t reach the car after a \"no\" to Android\'s question: the player and the phone\'s Home say so, with \"Ask again\".
With Xonos as the car\'s music, the assistant\'s replies and messages read aloud play in the car, and what starts after Xonos is heard from its first second.
While driving: the next turn stays in the dock for a whole call, What\'s new waits until the car stops, Back goes up a folder in the music list, and the wheel\'s Play no longer stops a film.
A connection that fails no longer pauses the phone\'s music, and the voice models load after the car\'s first picture, for a lighter start.
Plancia and Xonos inside myCar stay through a long tunnel instead of passing to their apps, and Cinema keeps the picture covered while the car moves even when the GPS loses its signal.

string-array.name: changelog_42
string-array.item: New Music section in the phone\'s settings: Xonos and Spotify each have a switch, and \"Add a service\" offers YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music, Deezer, TIDAL, SoundCloud and Qobuz. Only the services switched on are in the car; Xonos is on if you already used it.

Spotify and the other services play inside myCar from their own web player, laid out as on a computer: their sound reaches the car through myCar, even where the service\'s app keeps other apps from recording it.

They work like any music app: the song beside the map and in the dock, the steering-wheel buttons, and the voice assistant: ask for something to play and it searches the service and plays the first result.
Sign in once on the phone, with its keyboard and password manager: the car stays signed in.
The car\'s keyboard pastes what you copied on the phone, and copies from the page, in the browser, Cinema and the music services.
Every setting of the car\'s screen is on the phone too, in Settings > Car screen, with the same values as in the car: change one on either side and the other follows at once, during a drive too.
The pages beside the map can be changed from the phone: layout, what each part shows, their order, new pages, or back to the ready-made ones.
The car preview is the first thing at the top of the phone\'s Settings.

string-array.name: changelog_41
string-array.item: Connecting wirelessly by itself: while the phone waits for the car, it now calls the car\'s own Android Auto again every 8 seconds. A car still starting up didn\'t answer the first call, and myCar then only waited.
When a later step fails (the car\'s Wi-Fi, the connection), a start-up the car\'s Bluetooth began starts over by itself, up to three times, as \"Disconnect\" and \"Connect wirelessly\" did by hand.

A start-up that stalls (the car taking the Bluetooth channel and saying nothing, or stopping halfway) no longer stays stuck: it closes and starts again, and the car coming back is no longer taken for a drive still under way.
After a drive, myCar listens for the car again even when the car waits to be called, and stops when the car\'s Bluetooth goes.
A car still waiting for the picture gets it again: no more black screen until something moves.

string-array.name: changelog_40
string-array.item: The assistant no longer hangs after words it can\'t act on: it always closes by itself (after a question from Home Assistant too), and the microphone starts over at once. Home Assistant gets 15 seconds to answer.
In languages other than English, a phrase is no longer cut while you\'re still speaking: it ends once the microphone is quiet again.
When the phone has no voice model for myCar\'s language, the assistant says so while it listens, and which model to download.

Connecting wirelessly by itself no longer waits for the phone to be unlocked when myCar is already open behind the lock screen. Android\'s \"Allow\" comes up as soon as myCar is on screen, and the settings show the cars allowed.

string-array.name: changelog_39
string-array.item: After a wireless drive with a car that calls the phone, myCar keeps listening for it for ten minutes: after a short stop the car connects again by itself, even when its Bluetooth never dropped.
Connecting wirelessly with the phone in a pocket: myCar now puts itself in the foreground before joining the car\'s Wi-Fi, which Android refuses to an app in the background.
On Automatic, after a call the music waits for the car\'s Bluetooth to come back before moving to myCar.

string-array.name: changelog_38
string-array.item: Through myCar, music no longer stays off when the car takes the speakers for its own voice and forgets to give them back: after a while myCar asks for them again.
On Automatic, a Bluetooth music connection that drops for a call or a moment no longer moves the sound to myCar mid-drive: it waits for it to come back.
The player has a sound button: it shows whether the sound reaches the car over Bluetooth or through myCar, and a tap sends it the other way.
myCar remembers that choice for each car: one car can go through myCar while the others stay on Automatic.
Connecting wirelessly by itself: a car that calls the phone finds myCar ready at once, and myCar waits for it up to five minutes while the car\'s Android Auto starts.

string-array.name: changelog_37
string-array.item: On the phone, the band under the status bar takes the theme\'s colour too, with Light, Dark, Black and Monokai.

string-array.name: changelog_36
string-array.item: myCar speaks your language, on the phone and on the car\'s screen: English, Italian, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Greek, Russian or Chinese.
It follows the phone\'s language; to pick another, Settings > Language on the phone.
The voice assistant speaks all nine. Greek and Russian are heard by the multilingual Parakeet model, Chinese by Whisper: Settings > Voice says which one to download.
Xonos inside myCar speaks your language, and asks Music Assistant for its own words in it too.
On the phone, Settings is grouped into pages, and the app has themes: like the phone, light, dark, black (AMOLED) or Monokai (Settings > General).

string-array.name: changelog_35
string-array.item: With Home Assistant set up on the phone (Settings > Plancia), what the voice assistant can\'t do itself goes to the voice assistant you chose there: Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, a model at home, or Home Assistant\'s own, which runs the house.
\"Open the gate\", \"what\'s the date?\", \"and tomorrow?\": it answers in your language, and asks back when it needs to.
Phone locked with the phone\'s assistant chosen: myCar listens itself and Home Assistant answers, with nothing to unlock.

string-array.name: changelog_34
string-array.item: The voice assistant speaks your phone\'s language: Italian, Spanish, French, German or Portuguese. It listens, answers and shows its words in it.
It needs a speech model for that language: on the phone, Settings > Voice says which one, with a button to download it.
A third certificate for the newest cars: CarService, Android Auto\'s own. On the phone, Settings > Certificate.
Leaving Cinema, the music that was playing before the film starts again by itself.
On the phone, after each update, the pirate flag flies with the new version. Big releases bring a ship.

string-array.name: changelog_33
string-array.item: Phone: a Recents tab with your latest calls, and Call back on a missed call\'s popup.
Voice: \"read my messages\", \"reply to…\", \"call back\", \"redial\", and \"call Mom on mobile\" calls that number.
Play - said, or on the steering wheel - starts the music app you used last when none is open.
Quick replies go out in your phone\'s language. While a call rings, the next turn stays in the dock.
Dropdowns on web pages open in the car as a list to tap, and the car\'s Back key goes back inside apps.
Stop navigating takes two taps; screens that stopped at an error now have a way on.
Cinema: Continue opens again what you were watching; a film picks up where it stopped after a network drop.
Extra large fits better: settings keep whole words, the page bar keeps Done in sight, an app\'s menu scrolls.

string-array.name: changelog_32
string-array.item: New: Cinema. Your video sites (YouTube, RaiPlay, Twitch and any you add on the phone), the videos on your phone, and TV channels from an IPTV list. Video shows only when the car is parked; the sound carries on.
Pages beside the map take new layouts: a whole page, a half beside two quarters, a strip above or below two quarters. Pencil, then Layout.
Vela\'s turn arrow changes with the turn again, on the routing card and in the dock.
A dropdown on a web page no longer closes myCar.
Cars that never confirm the audio no longer lose two seconds at the start of the music, after a call and in the middle of spoken directions.
Wireless: a car that starts its connection over comes back by itself, and only cars you allowed can make myCar connect.
Decline works on a call that\'s already ringing, and Back on Android\'s permission question no longer stops the setup from asking again.

string-array.name: changelog_31
string-array.item: Wireless connects by itself: after your first drive without the cable, Android asks once, then myCar connects to that car whenever you start it. Settings > Connection turns it off.
Music playing over Bluetooth stays there: the car no longer switches to Android Auto\'s source the moment myCar connects.
Steadier car audio: fewer gaps, and cars that take only AAC get the start they expect.
The car\'s own margins stay right at every size, Small and Large included.
On the car\'s Phone screen, \"Ask on the phone\" asks for the missing permissions on the phone.
Map apps\' route options show time and distance, and a car app that never answers says so instead of \"Starting...\".

string-array.name: changelog_30
string-array.item: No Music Assistant at home? The Xonos app can now be one, on the phone itself: Xonos inside myCar plays from it, wirelessly too.
myCar wakes the Xonos app and its server as the drive starts. The first start takes a few seconds, and the car says so.

string-array.name: changelog_29
string-array.item: Plancia and Xonos now work wirelessly with Tailscale too: with myCar left out of Tailscale, they reach your servers through the Plancia and Xonos apps on the phone, which stay inside it.
Update the Plancia and Xonos apps, and keep them set to the same addresses as myCar. They open connections only for myCar, and only to their own server.
If even the apps can\'t reach your server, they take the place of the ones inside myCar for the drive, as before.

string-array.name: changelog_28
string-array.item: Plancia and Xonos keep working with Tailscale over wireless: when the ones inside myCar can\'t reach your server, the Plancia and Xonos apps on the phone take their place for the drive, by themselves.
The same when the address or the token set in myCar is wrong: the apps step in instead of an error.
Xonos connects as the drive starts, so it\'s ready when you open it.

string-array.name: changelog_27
string-array.item: Setup is one list on the phone, with one button for the next step. How to connect and Settings bring it back, with nothing reset.
A spare certificate: if your car turns down the first, myCar uses the other, and the phone says to connect again.
A car with its clock set wrong is now told apart: the phone says to check the car\'s date.

string-array.name: changelog_26
string-array.item: Plancia and Xonos say why they can\'t connect: Tailscale leaving myCar out, a Tailscale name that isn\'t found, or Android 17 keeping myCar off your home network.
The drive keeps going with the phone locked: myCar stays in the foreground, keeps the phone awake and, over wireless, the Wi-Fi at full speed.
When the car ends the session, myCar ends it too: the phone\'s sound comes back and Xonos stops, instead of playing on to nobody.
A music app that closes no longer leaves the player stuck, and a song already playing on the phone is the one the car shows.
Voice: \"call\" picks the right contact, \"stop navigation\" ends the route, and the music no longer stays paused after myCar speaks.
After screen sharing the car\'s music comes back: Android asks again for the car audio, one question at a time.
Dozens of smaller fixes: calls, messages, screen sharing, Plancia, the browser and wireless.

string-array.name: changelog_25
string-array.item: Plancia and Xonos reach your Home Assistant and Music Assistant at home again, plain http addresses included. On Android 17, myCar needs the Nearby devices permission for your home network, and now asks for it.
If that permission is missing, the car says so, rather than that Home Assistant or Music Assistant isn\'t answering.

string-array.name: changelog_24
string-array.item: Xonos is now part of myCar: your Music Assistant library among the car\'s music apps. Set it up on the phone, or bring your account over from the Xonos app with one tap.
With the car audio through myCar, Xonos plays straight into the car, and Android doesn\'t ask to share the audio while you listen to it.

string-array.name: changelog_23
string-array.item: Plancia is now part of myCar: your Home Assistant dashboards, ready the moment you open them, from the app grid, one of your pages, or beside the map.
Set Plancia up in myCar\'s settings on the phone, or bring your account over from the Plancia app with one tap.
Home Assistant\'s menu button opens Plancia\'s menu: your dashboards, the one that opens first, the size and Reload.

string-array.name: changelog_22
string-array.item: The music comes back after a call or the phone\'s assistant. Before, once the car took its speakers for a moment, the music stayed off until the next drive.
A new player: plain controls, a thin line to seek, the cover\'s colours behind it. The cover stays in sight while you browse.
With the phone locked, the microphone lights the phone and asks you to unlock it; your assistant starts listening as soon as it opens.
Android\'s question for the car audio is one tap: no app to pick, and every app\'s sound reaches the car.

string-array.name: changelog_21
string-array.item: Pages beside the map: swipe across Home, or tap the dots at its foot. Ready-made, the weather and your agenda left of the map, and Plancia\'s dashboard beside the browser right of it.
The pencil beside the dots changes a page: two halves or four parts, each the weather, the agenda, the browser or a car app such as Plancia. Add, move and delete pages there too.

string-array.name: changelog_20
string-array.item: The phone\'s music no longer stays muted if myCar was closed mid-drive while sending the sound to the car.
Saying yes to Android\'s audio or screen-sharing question after the car has gone no longer mutes the phone or leaves it sharing.
Less memory during drives without voice commands, and old logs no longer pile up on the phone.

string-array.name: changelog_19
string-array.item: myCar no longer risks closing at the end of a drive with the phone locked.
The weather finds where you are without the twelve-second wait.
Long drives with lots of music use far less memory: cover art is sized for the car\'s screen.

string-array.name: changelog_18
string-array.item: Car audio: Automatic, now the default, plays over Bluetooth when the car takes the phone\'s music that way, and through myCar otherwise, over the cable or Wi-Fi.
USB audio is now called Through myCar: it works over Wi-Fi too.

string-array.name: changelog_17
string-array.item: Beside the map: the music player while something plays, as before, or an app of your choice, such as Plancia or Xonos, always there. Pick it in the car\'s settings.
The microphone stays at the foot of the dock, just above the app grid button, however many apps are open.
The phone\'s assistant now wakes the way the swipe up from a bottom corner of the phone wakes it. Choose it under the car\'s Settings > Voice assistant.
Moving wallpapers: Lava, Polar, Waves and Fireflies, under Wallpaper in the car\'s settings, below the still ones.
A new myCar icon.
Vela Maps no longer carries the yellow \"works in part\" mark: it navigates with myCar.

string-array.name: changelog_16
string-array.item: Gemini opens listening too: myCar asks the Google app, which listens for Gemini, and opens a typed chat only if no app will listen.
On the app grid, the button at the foot of the dock takes you back to the map with the music beside it.
Moving wallpapers: set Wallpaper motion to Moving in the car\'s settings, and the colours drift slowly.

string-array.name: changelog_15
string-array.item: Two smaller sizes for the car screen: Small (90%) and Extra small (83%), in the car\'s settings.
The phone\'s assistant opens listening, as from the corner of the phone\'s screen, not in its typed chat.
Screen sharing turns the phone sideways, so apps fill the car\'s wide screen. It turns back when you stop.

string-array.name: changelog_14
string-array.item: Music and map share the screen again: the player sits beside the map as soon as something plays.
Tap the song in the dock to put the player away or bring it back. Hold it for the full player.

string-array.name: changelog_13
string-array.item: Wallpapers behind the app grid and the dashboard, with the dock in glass over them. Pick one, or none, in the car\'s settings.
Icons in glass: light along the edges and a soft shine.
The player beside the map fills its side with the cover, its controls on frosted glass.
Choose the voice assistant: myCar\'s own, the phone\'s, or another assistant app.
Apps that work only in part with myCar have a yellow mark.

string-array.name: changelog_12
string-array.item: A new look: a dock down the left with the clock and your apps, and the app grid in pages.
App icons sit in a rounded square frame, and the car screen uses the Inter typeface.
Dark by default. Choose light, or follow the phone, in the car\'s settings.
Tap the song in the dock to put the player beside the map. Hold it for the full player.
Calls reach the car only over Bluetooth, USB audio or not. myCar now says when the phone isn\'t connected, and when a call is playing on the phone.
Car apps show their own icons again, instead of another app\'s.

string-array.name: changelog_11
string-array.item: Gearslip is now myCar, with a new name and icon. Updates come from github.com/sirionero/mycar.
Calls from your contacts show on the car screen, and you can answer or decline them there.
A call card no longer stays on the screen after you decline, or when the caller hangs up.
End a call from the car screen or the steering wheel.

string-array.name: changelog_9
string-array.item: Wireless Android Auto: pair the phone with the car once, and leave the cable at home.
Voice control is built in. Say \"navigate to a gas station\", \"play\" a song or artist, or open an app by name.
\"Navigate to\" picks the nearest place and stops at the map app\'s start screen, so you only tap Start.
myCar turns speech into text on the phone, with no Google account. Download the voice models once in setup.
The car\'s rotary knob moves between buttons, so cars without a touchscreen work too.
Choose how music reaches the car: Bluetooth, or USB with no delay. myCar offers to pair with the car the first time.
The car speaks each turn from your map app, and shows the directions on its own display where it can.
The car shows what\'s playing, and music apps get their own like, shuffle and repeat buttons.
Pick how the car\'s buttons look. Change it any time in the car\'s settings.
A new destination mid-route replaces the old route, and switching map apps ends the old app\'s route.
The car warns you when the phone\'s location is off.
myCar finds new versions and installs them for you.
More cars play music over USB, show a sharper picture, and put taps where you press.
On GrapheneOS, myCar no longer needs exploit protection compatibility mode.
The app is half the size it was.

string-array.name: changelog_8
string-array.item: Exit takes you to the car\'s own screen. Tap Android Auto on the car to come back.
myCar listens through the car\'s microphone when the car has one, so voice works with the phone in a pocket.
A voice reply sends when its bar runs out, even over road noise or the radio. Say \"cancel\" or \"change it\" before then.
Maps turn dark when the car switches to night mode.
A moving map no longer makes the car screen fall behind your taps.
myCar asks to send sound to the car as soon as you connect, so videos in the web browser play in the car too.
Cars that offer more than one kind of music audio, such as the 2022 Dacia Jogger, play sound again.
When the car shows a keyboard, you can type on the phone instead. The car\'s keyboard is taller too.
Every car screen has a back button.
App icons show whether an app works in myCar. Metrolist works and shows the green check.
LIVI connects again, and touch works on cars with a second screen.
The phone\'s Settings screen has a new layout, with What\'s new and the setup guide at the top.
You can choose to send short usage notes that help the project. They hold no name, account, or location, and they\'re off unless you turn them on.
Searching inside a media app moved to Settings > Experimental features.
Under Settings > Media audio, the choices are now Phone audio and Car audio.
Logs leave out your location and the car\'s serial number.

string-array.name: changelog_7
string-array.item: The launcher groups your apps: Phone, Maps, Music, Messaging, Web, Screen sharing, and Settings.
To move an app, press and hold it on the launcher, then tap Move left or Move right.
MapQuest and Flitsmeister work in myCar and show the green check.
Spotify has one tile. If Spotify isn\'t open on the phone, tap Open Spotify to start it.
Flick a map and it glides on, as it does in Android Auto.
The map picks up where it left off when you come back from another screen.
Search boxes in map apps are larger and easier to read.
Map apps keep the right icons on their buttons after they update.
When myCar asks \"Do you want to reply?\", a bar shows how long it will listen. The bar stops while you speak.
myCar fits its picture to wide car screens and keeps it clear of the edges the car crops.
myCar answers the car\'s connection checks correctly. Some cars, Audis among them, hung up after a second without this.
Google Maps no longer shows up as a messaging app.

string-array.name: changelog_6
string-array.item: Messaging apps such as Signal and Molly open to your recent chats.
myCar reads a message aloud, and you reply by voice. Say \"cancel\" or \"change it\" before it sends, or tap a quick reply such as your arrival time.
Voice works on any phone, GrapheneOS included. myCar turns speech into text itself, so it needs no Google account.
New messages show as a small card at the top right, even while you drive. A bar shows how long until the card closes or the reply sends.
Only messages, missed calls, alarms, and reminders pop up. Everything else waits on the dashboard.
The map stays loaded when you switch screens, so it no longer flashes black.
Map apps draw more reliably and keep their connection when the phone is locked.
The Home button shows your map app, so it no longer appears twice.
The next turn shows in the nav bar when you leave the map.
Steering wheel buttons, control knobs, and D-pads now work. If yours don\'t, open an issue on GitHub.
To see the whole song title and artist in the nav bar, choose Settings > Player in the nav bar > Song title.
Choose miles or kilometres under Settings > Units.
Try the voice assistant and the vehicle data screen under Settings > Experimental features.
Logs now say why a car ended the connection.

Spotify, Waze, and Google Messages updated to a version of Google\'s car library that only accepts Android Auto itself. Their own car screens won\'t open in myCar. Spotify still plays through the myCar player, which has the green check.
Calls go through the car\'s Bluetooth, as they do in Android Auto. Pair your phone with the car to hear calls on its speakers.
